annotations.title: Find real churches near a place, or one church by id

description: Real churches and congregations near a place, nearest first, or one church by id. Modes: near, by_id. City level only. Example: {mode:"near", city:"Seattle"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/find_churches. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

country.description: For by_id without id. Country name or code.

denomination.description: For near: one lowercase tradition word: "baptist", "catholic", "methodist".

id.description: For by_id: the full id, e.g. "lb:church:colombia/iglesia-la-capuchina".

mode.description: The kind of answer. Leave out for a guide to the modes.

slug.description: For by_id without id: the church slug, e.g. "iglesia-la-capuchina".
